violation_type.title: Written Operational Policies - Setting (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(D))
violation_type.typical_finding: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state in which setting physical activity will be held.

finding_variants.text: During inspection, Operational Policies did not state in which setting physical activity will be held.
The operational policies did not include the promotion of indoor and outdoor activities.

At the time of reviewing the Operational Policy, it was missing a plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play, and the criteria you will use to determine when extreme weather conditions occur.  In addition, methods and strategies for preventing and responding to abuse and neglect of children    NOTE: This was corrected at inspection as it was added to the handbook.
The operational policy was observed missing the required information for each setting in which physical activity program will take place.
Operational policies did not state the setting in which physical activity will take place.
The operational policies are lacking required information regarding employee vaccination requirements, promotion of outdoor play, and criteria for determining extreme weather.
